disclosure: This sensitivity study was designed after the Phase-7 t=1.0 result and reviewer feedback were known. It cannot alter or rescue the Phase-7 primary claim. It reuses the frozen canonical prompt surface and action pools, fits only on Phase-5 train/calibration outcomes, freezes all target-specific predictions and actions before any new outcome is read, and reports all targets and references together.
purpose: Test target heterogeneity on fresh canonical prompt strings and restore the same-basis target-specific transformed-mean control used in Phase 6.
observer_basis: intercept, 13 head indicators, and all 78 distinct head-pair products (92 columns)
direct_risk_response: For each target, fit the calibration-mask train-prompt mean of |Y-t|.
natural_mean_response: Fit the calibration-mask train-prompt mean of Y once, then select by |predicted mean-t|.
transformed_mean_response: For each target, fit |train-prompt mean(Y)-t| with the same 92-column basis and raw, unclipped prediction rule used by the Phase-6 target-specific Jensen-score sensitivity.
noop_rule: Set the exact no-op finite effect to zero and target loss to |t| for every selector and target; never run a no-op ablation.
selection_rule: Within each inherited Phase-7 pool, lexicographically minimize (raw predicted target loss, ablated-head count, action id).

comparisons: direct risk versus natural mean plug-in
bootstrap.reporting: Report each target separately and an equal-target pooled descriptive contrast. No Phase-8 threshold licenses a primary claim.

new_outcome_access_rule: Freeze predictions, actions, and the new selected-mask union before reading any newly measured outcome.
reuse_rule: Reuse a Phase-7 selected-mask outcome only after validating the Phase-7 measurement manifest, selected-mask hash, shard hashes, prompt bank, mask mapping, and clean scores. Measure only the frozen set difference between the Phase-8 selected union and the 89-mask Phase-7 measured union.
claim_boundary: All results are labeled post-confirmatory secondary sensitivity analyses. The t=1.0 Phase-7 joint primary result remains unchanged. Results at t=0.5 or t=1.5 establish target dependence only on this frozen action family and prompt surface.
forbidden_after_freeze: change targets, observers, ridge, basis, prompts, masks, pools, or selection rule
read a newly measured outcome before the pre-outcome audit passes
suppress an unfavorable target or reference
describe this post-review sensitivity as preregistered or primary
